title: Imprezia Adapter Params
description: A schema which validates params accepted by the Imprezia adapter

response.description: The AI-generated response text to monetize

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 instant the chat turn completed (not when the request was sent). Required by Imprezia's own API but never JSON-schema-required here — dynamic per-auction field, same rule as request/response (see imprezia.go's package doc).

deviceContext.description: The end user's viewport/device shape. Required by Imprezia's own API but never JSON-schema-required here — dynamic per-auction field, same rule as request/response.

siteId.description: Imprezia surface UUID for this publisher, e.g. sayhola's cbc68717-3d85-4d55-9a29-e7a1a22ab4ef

placementId.description: Our own stable placement label, e.g. chat_followup — auto-registers on first successful request if unregistered

maxCards.description: Max sponsored cards to return (default 2 on Imprezia's side; we request 1 by default)

bidPrice.description: Overrides global extra_info.bidPrice when set — Imprezia returns no price
